description: This file defines a class 'MultiFileSearchReplaceDiffStrategy' implementing diff-based search and replace strategies across multiple files, including fuzzy matching, line number handling, and diff validation.

classes.name: MultiFileSearchReplaceDiffStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing a diff strategy for multi-file search and replace with fuzzy matching, line number handling, and diff validation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the diff strategy.

methods.name: getToolDescription
methods.description: Provides a detailed description of the diff tool and its usage.

methods.name: unescapeMarkers
methods.description: Replaces escaped diff markers with their unescaped versions.

methods.name: validateMarkerSequencing
methods.description: Validates the sequence and structure of diff markers in the diff content.

methods.name: applyDiff
methods.description: Applies the diff to the original content, supporting multiple files and diff blocks.

methods.name: applySingleDiff
methods.description: Processes a single diff block and applies it to the original content, with validation and fuzzy matching.

methods.name: getProgressStatus
methods.description: Provides progress status during diff application, including partial counts.
